title: Zesty Silky Italian Boudin Blanc Tagliatelle
description: A winey and silky Italian dish featuring boudin-blanc, sashimi-cut, and lacto-vegetarian-friendly ingredients, served with tagliatelle and cooked on a comal.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the tagliatelle according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the garlic until fragrant.
Add the white wine to the skillet and cook until reduced by half.
Add the boudin blanc to the skillet and cook until heated through.
Stir in the lemon juice and cook for an additional minute.
Combine the cooked tagliatelle, boudin blanc mixture, and parmesan cheese in a large serving dish.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately on a comal.
Drizzle with additional olive oil if desired.
